pressure_hypothesis.title: The session activity projection exposes only a bounded newest operation window
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: Environment session event Store and environmental capability projection
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The authenticated session contains 128 captured Control read-operation events while one projection returns at most 32. A bounded sequence cursor now allows an agent to inspect earlier event pages without loading the full canonical event payload history.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Use the exclusive event cursor and exact event references to inspect older authenticated activity when the projection reports omitted records; continue collecting cross-session evidence before treating this as a recurring pressure.
